sidebar.tutorialSidebar.category.Buffers.message: A buffer is an optional component type that immediately follows the input layer and can be used as a way to decouple the transaction model from downstream components such as processing layers and outputs. This is considered a high-level component, as most users may not benefit from buffers, but they allow you to group messages using windowing algorithms.
